notes: Soft gaps: the scoring method (option match vs SME check) is not fully described and the gpt-4-turbo snapshot is not stated (Sept 2025 preprint, resolved by the date rule).

resolution.plan: The scoring is stated in Methods: accuracy = number of responses whose selected option matches the SME-verified correct option, out of 225. Take the 225 MCQ-style questions with ground truth from Supplementary Table 1 / huggingface.co/datasets/Wellytics/PGxRAG, send each question as-is (Table 1 format, no system prompt) to gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0, extract the chosen option and compare with 182/225 (Table 2).
resolution.approximation: Snapshot by date rule; free-text answers mapped to options by a fixed parser.
